method: Reverse DCF: solve FCF growth g such that PV of 10y FCF + terminal (g_term 2.5%) at 10% discount, plus cash, equals last close. Profitable positive-FCF names only. Excluded: pre-revenue/negative-FCF story names (OKLO, SMR, IONQ, RGTI, CRWV, NBIS, ASTS, HTZ, APLD, TE, OPEN) and banks/insurers (GS, JPM, SOFI) where reverse-DCF is meaningless. TTM FCF/shares/cash from stockanalysis.com (fundamentals stable qtr-to-qtr); prices refreshed 2026-07-09 close.
